english: Then I disagree with that third point above: I disagree that there are many examples of things which are not unchanging things but which are still knowable things. Suppose you do disagree. In that case, let us again consider unchanging things. It is so the case that there are many examples of things which are not unchanging things but which are still knowable things, Because a coffee cup is one such example; and a coffee table is another. 6 Is There Anything Which Is Both a Quality And Also Characteristic of a Quality, Which Is Not Also Both the Quality of Which Unchanging Things Are Characteristic, And Also Characteristic of Unchanging Things?
